headerFooter.hf.header.note: U:grid/header-and-footer: checked against gridcraft (paper_view.rs ribbon_tab): the header presets as the result will read, with this sheet's and file's names; choosing one writes it for the kind of page being edited and ends the edit.

headerFooter.hf.footer.note: U:grid/header-and-footer: checked against gridcraft (paper_view.rs ribbon_tab): the footer presets as the result will read, with this sheet's and file's names; choosing one writes it for the kind of page being edited and ends the edit.

headerFooter.elements.pageNumber.note: U:grid/header-and-footer: checked against gridcraft (paper_view.rs insert_field): inserts &[Page] at the caret of the section being edited.

headerFooter.elements.numberofPages.note: U:grid/header-and-footer: checked against gridcraft (paper_view.rs insert_field): inserts &[Pages] at the caret of the section being edited.

headerFooter.elements.currentDate.note: U:grid/header-and-footer: checked against gridcraft (paper_view.rs insert_field): inserts &[Date] at the caret of the section being edited.

headerFooter.elements.currentTime.note: U:grid/header-and-footer: checked against gridcraft (paper_view.rs insert_field): inserts &[Time] at the caret of the section being edited.

headerFooter.elements.filePath.note: U:grid/header-and-footer: checked against gridcraft (paper_view.rs insert_field): inserts &[Path]&[File] at the caret of the section being edited.

headerFooter.elements.fileName.note: U:grid/header-and-footer: checked against gridcraft (paper_view.rs insert_field): inserts &[File] at the caret of the section being edited.

headerFooter.elements.sheetName.note: U:grid/header-and-footer: checked against gridcraft (paper_view.rs insert_field): inserts &[Tab] at the caret of the section being edited.

headerFooter.elements.picture.note: U:grid/header-and-footer: gridcraft keeps &[Picture] as a field name only (no picture is stored or printed); hidden.

headerFooter.elements.formatPicture.note: U:grid/header-and-footer: a header picture is not stored (see Picture); hidden.

headerFooter.navigation.goToHeader.note: U:grid/header-and-footer: checked against gridcraft (paper_view.rs go_to): moves the edit to the header of the same page.

headerFooter.navigation.goToFooter.note: U:grid/header-and-footer: checked against gridcraft (paper_view.rs go_to): moves the edit to the footer of the same page.

dialog.formatPicture.note: U:grid/header-and-footer: not translated (a header picture is not stored); nothing opens it.
